ios.desc:
Is AWS down? Is Vercel having issues? Stop refreshing status pages. Pingy monitors 50+ cloud services and alerts you the moment something goes wrong.

KNOW BEFORE IT STARTS TRENDING
Get instant push notifications when services experience outages, degraded performance, or incidents. Be the first on your team to know, not the last.

50+ CLOUD SERVICES TRACKED
  - Hyperscalers: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Oracle Cloud
  - Developer Tools: Vercel, GitHub, Netlify, Railway, Render, Fly.io
  - AI & ML: OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Replicate, ElevenLabs
  - Databases: MongoDB Atlas, Supabase, PlanetScale, Neon, Pinecone
  - Payments & Comms: Stripe, Twilio, Resend, Postmark
  - And many more...

One dashboard to monitor everything your app depends on. See which services need attention and which are running smoothly, with a visual dashboard. 

BUILT FOR DEVELOPERS
  - Clean, dark-mode native interface
  - No spam, ever. Only status alerts.
  - One-time Lifetime Pass. No subscriptions.
  - Free to start with 1 cloud service

quotes.text:
I was sick of finding out a cloud provider was down when casually doomscrolling on X in the middle of work. So I built Pingy as a fun side project, it sends me a push notification whenever a cloud provider is experiencing an outage or a degradation.

AWS, GCP, Azure, GitHub, Stripe, OpenAI, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, and 50+ more are tracked. I just pushed it App Store yesterday and if you are paranoid like me, checkout Pingy on the App Store.
